name: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS), Atmosphere Data Store
kind: air quality forecast API (needs an account and key)
gives: CAMS European air quality forecasts and analyses (PM, NO2, O3, pollen), global atmospheric composition forecasts

why.quote: Here is how to setup the CDS Api key: If you do not have an account yet, please
why.basis: how-to-api page (account and token required); robots.txt: 'User-agent: *' 'Allow: /'

interface: Python cdsapi client or the REST API with a personal access token from a free account. GRIB or NetCDF.
notes: WAITING FOR A KEY: answer to the brief's question is 'account, not keyless'. Keyless alternatives for air quality: the EEA download service above (measurements) and Open-Meteo's air quality endpoint, which is built on CAMS (its own terms to read). Licence per dataset not read.
